page.notes: The running head carries the book marker "LIB. II." at the right, which is left out as a number. The page number is printed in an old-style figure that reads as 80; the first digit is doubtful. The text continues beyond the bottom of this part. The sign before "Antoninum" (a curved stroke over the A) is doubtful and may be a printer's ornament or a reference mark; it is not transcribed. The word "adc-" is the catchword, a hyphenated start of the next line, not a complete word. Some italic letters at the line ends are faint, and the reading of "cùm" (accent) and "præ" (ligature) follows the scan as best as possible.
